draft_en.subject: The 5-port copper switch you asked about - desk or cabinet
draft_en.body:
Hi Julien,

You asked on our site about a 5-port copper switch; two options depending on where it goes:

- indoor desk or shelf: 5 x Gigabit desktop switch, metal case - model STC-05GE - $6.2 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity)
- inside a cabinet or outdoor enclosure: DIN-rail industrial 5 x Gigabit, 12-58 V DC, -40 to 75 C - STI-050GE - $25.0

Both CE/RoHS; shipping to France is quoted on top once I know the quantity.

One question: is it going on a desk or inside a cabinet?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
